assumptions: The uploaded Organization Agent Mesh v1.0.0 package is the seed baseline.
V26 is the canonical active bootstrap generation; V25 R11 and earlier remain preserved historical lineage only.
authoritative_sources: uploaded org-agent-mesh-framework-v1.0.0 package as preserved seed lineage
completion_definition: V26 canonical bootstrap identity, VMBUS/principal-context readiness, project isolation, capability, communication, concurrency, deployment package, test and documentation controls are synchronized and exact-SHA release-gate validated.
constraints: V26 VMBUS_READY must be satisfied before project binding
V26 PRINCIPAL_CONTEXT_READY must be satisfied before project binding and task interpretation
Intercommunication Enhancements is the only shared coordination project; shared protocol does not imply shared project state or authority
CV Support remains non-federated and isolated from shared project coordination
Do not modify peer project repositories from this project
Do not silently elevate agent authority
Slack is an optional scheduled-task transport and not canonical project state
Recursive learning may observe peers read-only but may graft changes only into this project after local review
Preserve at least 20 percent verified repository/artifact capacity for essential writes when a hard limit is known
Unknown repository/artifact capacity must never be interpreted as unlimited
Current human project intent and the local identity lock must be validated after V26 standalone readiness and project binding before continuation state becomes actionable
Durable persistence adapters must preserve atomic lease and compare-and-set semantics or fail closed
Mutation authority must be derived from an ACTIVE bound execution session plus current case-bound authorization, not caller-supplied identity strings
Canonical identifiers must be validated without lossy sanitization
desired_outcome: A reusable, fail-closed V26 intercommunication control plane in which Intercommunication Enhancements supplies the shared coordination interface while every participating project retains isolated state, authority and VMBUS namespaces, with CV Support excluded from federation.
non_goals: Implement domain logic for Duo Open
Create shared mutable state between projects
Use Slack as canonical accepted state
Create a central controller that may mutate peer projects
problem_statement: Harden the Organization Agent Mesh inter-agent communication architecture for safe simultaneous operation of multiple unrelated projects while preserving project-specific autonomy, isolated state/authority, and synchronized V26 deployable agent packages.
prohibited_actions: Write to CV Support or federate CV Support
Write to any peer repository during self-enhancement observation
Guess project identity for mutating operations
Authorize mutation from an unverified caller-supplied project_id
Lossily sanitize canonical identifiers into colliding keys
Guess a Slack destination for scheduled-task delivery
Invent a provider hard limit or treat an unknown capacity limit as unlimited
Allow an unbound agent to mutate project state
Silently accept a stale state version
Allow a restarted execution instance to inherit an earlier instance-owned lease
Treat V25 R11 or earlier lineage as the current active bootstrap generation
success_criteria: V26 is the only canonical active bootstrap generation on current surfaces
VMBUS_READY and PRINCIPAL_CONTEXT_READY occur before project binding and task interpretation
Current project intent and identity lock are validated after V26 standalone readiness before continuation state or mutable work
Concurrent projects cannot accidentally route or mutate across namespaces
Unbound or forged caller identity cannot authorize mutation
Child agents inherit project identity and cannot escalate parent capabilities
Canonical resource identifiers cannot collide through normalization
Project-scoped leases recover without stale execution-instance inheritance
One project can pause or drain without stopping unrelated projects
Duplicate deliveries are safe no-ops and invalid/expired messages remain non-executable quarantine evidence
Every deployable runtime/schema/protocol dependency and the V26 canonical adapter/manifest are captured by the package dependency map
PRIMARY, MANAGER and RESEARCH packages are reproducible, role-correct and traceable to one exact source revision
A participating project can adopt the shared interface without receiving another project's state or authority
